name: Yaounde
description: Cameroon's capital city in the Centre Region.
image_attribution: Emmanuel Taquet — Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
location_notes: The pin sits on the centre of Yaounde's urban community. Use it to orient yourself, then open one of the individual listings below for a specific place to visit.
cost_notes: Rough daily budget for one visitor covering local transport, meals and small entry fees. Not a surveyed figure.

name: Reunification Monument
description: A monument in Yaounde commemorating the reunification of Cameroon.
image_attribution: Steve Mvondo — Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
address: Centre Administratif, Yaounde III, Centre, Cameroon
location_notes: The monument stands in the Centre Administratif district, south-west of the city centre. It is an outdoor landmark, visible and photographable from the surrounding square.
cost_notes: Free to view from the square. Any guided tour or interior access would be extra.

name: National Museum
description: Housed in the former presidential palace, this museum showcases Cameroon's cultural heritage, traditional crafts, and historical artifacts.
image_attribution: Manuella sali — Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
address: Rue 3.038, Centre Administratif, Yaounde III, Cameroon
location_notes: Housed in the former presidential palace on Rue 3.038 in the Centre Administratif district. The pin is on the building itself.
cost_notes: Typical museum admission for one adult. Check current prices before travelling.

name: Mount Febe
description: A hill near Yaounde, distinct from the Hotel Mont Febe and its swimming pool.
image_attribution: Emmanuel Taquet — Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
address: Mont Febe, north-west of Yaounde, Centre, Cameroon
location_notes: The pin marks the summit of the hill, not a trailhead or car park. The hotel and its pool are separate listings further down the slope.
cost_notes: No charge for the hill itself. Budget for the taxi up and back.

name: Biyeme Market
description: Market listing associated with the Biyem-Assi market name in Yaounde; the legacy name is retained.
image_attribution: Local asset: creator and license unverified.

location_notes: The Grand Marche de Biyem-Assi, on Avenue de Mvolye in Yaounde VI. Busiest in the morning.

name: Yaounde Grand Mosque
description: Legacy mosque listing whose exact mosque identity still needs confirmation.
location_notes: The Grande Mosquee on Rue 2.375 in the Tsinga quarter of Yaounde II. It is an active place of worship, so dress modestly and ask before entering or photographing.
cost_notes: No admission charge.

name: Mvog-Betsi Zoo
description: The Mvog-Betsi zoo-botanical park in Yaounde.
image_attribution: Eleazar — Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
location_notes: The zoo-botanical park in Mvog-Betsi, south-west of the centre. Allow a couple of hours.
cost_notes: Typical zoo admission for one adult. Confirm on arrival.

name: Bastos District
description: Bastos is a neighborhood of Yaounde, not a specific restaurant.
image_attribution: Shaowu Fan — Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0
location_notes: Bastos is a residential and diplomatic quarter north of the centre, known for restaurants and nightlife. The pin is the middle of the quarter, not any single venue.
cost_notes: Free to walk around. Spending depends on where you stop.

name: Mount Cameroon
description: An active volcano in Cameroon's Southwest Region near Buea.
image_attribution: Daina — Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0
address: Mount Cameroon, near Buea, Southwest, Cameroon
location_notes: The pin is the summit, reached on foot from Buea over one to three days. Climbs are arranged through guides in Buea; do not set out alone.
cost_notes: Indicative daily cost of a guided climb including guide and porter fees. Operators vary widely.

name: Limbe Botanic Garden

location_notes: On the Morton Bay coast in Limbe, at the mouth of the Limbe River. The pin is the garden, not a named gate.

name: Chutes de la Lobé
description: Waterfalls where the Lobe River reaches the Atlantic, south of Kribi.

location_notes: The falls meet the Atlantic about 7 km south of Kribi. The pin is the falls; boat trips are arranged on the beach nearby.
cost_notes: Indicative cost of local access and a short boat trip. Negotiated on the day.
